s.how: Slice 600g potatoes 1.5mm thick on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and a little green chilli powder while hot.

Pop 100g kernels and spread on a lined tray. Drizzle over 150g melted white chocolate and toss gently. Scatter with red and blue sprinkles and 2 packets of popping candy before it sets. Break into clusters.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika and garlic. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours, then unwrap and glaze under a hot grill. Char 4 corn cobs. Toss 1kg boiled potatoes with Dijon, oil and vinegar.

w.how: Put a slab sponge cake on a board. Whip 600ml cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar and spread over the top. Fill the top left corner with 125g blueberries for stars, and lay rows of halved strawberries, 500g in total, for stripes.

d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and some cold water. Bury eight 375ml cans of American lager for an hour. Hand them out cold and toast the Fourth of July.
